description: PROVISIONAL 24-10-2026. One band covers the whole day; no day/night split has been given. Order is the owner's preferred runway mode list, strict (no ties): 1 27AD34D; 2 16A27D; 3 09A16D; 4 34A27AD-LAHSO (LAHSO). 34A27AD (the non-LAHSO twin of 34A27AD-LAHSO, added 24-10-2026) is priority 5: below 34A27AD-LAHSO and above the single-runway fallback modes, at a placeholder penalty of 15 (between 12 and 20) for the owner to confirm. The four single-runway fallback modes (27AD, 16AD, 34AD, 09AD) are lower priority than all of those, 34A27AD included; 27AD, 16AD and 34AD are equal priority, and 09AD is the single lowest priority of every mode (owner, 24-10-2026). The penalties are placeholders on the same design-example scale used for Sydney; lower is preferred. Replace with real figures when supplied.
